highlights.title: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, saying it generates images 50% faster, and adds animated GIF creation from prompts or photos
highlights.description: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, saying it generates images 50% faster, and adds animated GIF creation from prompts or photos — You can use ChatGPT to edit a GIF's animation speed and individual frames. … ChatGPT can now create GIFs using a prompt or a photo uploaded to the AI chatbot.

highlights.title: HomePod Mini 2's Amount of RAM Confirmed
highlights.description: MacRumors has confirmed that the HomePod mini 2 is equipped with 2GB of RAM supplied by SK Hynix. This is not very surprising given the S10 chip in the Apple Watch Series 10 also has 2GB of RAM, but Apple does not list this information in its tech specs for the HomePod mini 2, so it is worth documenting. highlights.title: NextDC shares surge 43% after Goodman, Digital Realty stake purchases
highlights.description: NextDC shares surged more than 40% Thursday morning after Goodman Group and Digital Realty sought to acquire up to a 9.9% stake.

highlights.title: South Korea’s Current Account Surplus Hits Record on Chip Boom
highlights.description: South Korea’s current-account surplus jumped to a record in September, fueled by booming semiconductor exports as global investment in artificial intelligence continues to stoke demand for the country’s technology products.

highlights.title: Apple Releases Safari Technology Preview 256 With Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements
